legend-turkey-lycian-coast-d400.story: curated scenic road. Mediterranean coast, mountains, ancient sites. 201 km from Fethiye to Antalya, about 3 h 39 of riding. The stops in between: Kalkan, Kaş, Demre and Kemer. The highest point is about 900 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Turkey Lycian Coast D400
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 21 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
